By

watching

tapes ,

was
determined
if
a
crab

visible ,
the

of
the
crab ,
and
any
interaction
which
may
tell
more
about
the
relationship

between
the
crab
and
anemone .

crabs
are
often
covered
with
sediment

and
are
smaller
in
size
than
their
coelentarate
hosts ,
and
thus
are
not

easily
seen
with
the
ROV
unless
the
camera
is
paused
and
focused
closely

on
the
corallimorph
on

canyon
wall .
